description: Run one of this firm's approved automation scripts now. Scripts are authored with manage_storage, reviewed, then approved; only approved ones run. Shapes: search_guides.

script.description: File name of an approved script, e.g. 'close_stale_incidents.py'. A script that has not been approved will not run — approve it first.

params.description: Arguments for the script's run(ctx, **params) entrypoint. Pass what that script's signature declares; a mismatch comes back naming the parameter.
